verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Connect offers configurable onboarding paths: an embedded onboarding component, or a fully custom UI built on the API. It also offers identity verification, Dashboard review of connected accounts, and Connect webhooks, which together imply some ability to shape onboarding and track account status. Nothing in the pack documents incremental or deferred requirement collection, or per-seller requirements-due states. Missing for 10: explicit incremental onboarding (minimum upfront, the rest later), requirement collection tied to payout or volume thresholds, documented per-seller requirements states (e.g. currently due / eventually due / past due), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
